# External simple mod (ImGui Direct3D 7)

Implements the Simple Mod Menu using the Dear ImGui Direct3D 7 renderer (`src/mod_base/imgui_menu_host.cpp`) with the same menu items and native actions as `demos/internal/simple-mod`:
- Weather (`Off`, `Rain`)
- FPS (`30`, `60`, `120`)
- Weapon (`Glock 17`, `MP5SD`, `UZI`, `M16A2`, `AK-47`, `Dragunov SVD`, `Minimi`, `Spas 12`)
- Pick Up Selected Weapon
- Camera View (`First Person`, `Third Person`)
- Level (`Level 1` .. `Level 14`)
- SFX Volume (`Normal`, `Low`, `Mute`)
- Clear Screen Flash
- Log Engine Performance

Build target: `igi_simple_mod_menu_external` (`igi-simple-mod-external.dll`).
